CREATE TABLE "qa"."unusual_transaction_log" (
    "archive_key_id" bigint DEFAULT nextval('qa.unusual_transaction_log_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL,
    "id" bigint NOT NULL,
    "set_id" bigint,
    "review_id" bigint,
    "referral_source" character varying(100),
    "external_source" character varying(100),
    "customers" character varying(500),
    "document_link" character varying(500),
    "reason" character varying(150),
    "details" text,
    "status" text,
    "created_on" timestamp without time zone,
    "created_by" character varying(150),
    "modified_on" timestamp without time zone,
    "modified_by" character varying(150),
    "archive_action_on" timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    "archive_action_code" character varying(2) NOT NULL
);
ALTER TABLE "qa"."unusual_transaction_log" ADD CONSTRAINT "unusual_transaction_log_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (archive_key_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_unusual_transaction_log_id ON qa.unusual_transaction_log USING btree (id);
CREATE INDEX ix_unusual_transaction_log_review_id ON qa.unusual_transaction_log USING btree (review_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_utr_log_finalized_review ON qa.unusual_transaction_log USING btree (review_id, archive_action_on DESC) WHERE ((archive_action_code)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('F'::character varying)::text, ('FE'::character varying)::text]));
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE "qa"."unusual_transaction_log" TO "app.app.sql.readers";
